salesforce:query.doc:name: fetch by Id
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Name, ProductCode, ExternalId, Id, Description, ProductPrice__c, IsActive, CurrencyCode__c FROM Product2 WHERE ExternalId = ':id'

salesforce:query-all.doc:name: fetch all product
salesforce:query-all.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Name, Id, ExternalId, ProductCode, CurrencyCode__c, ProductPrice__c, Description, IsActive, IsDeleted FROM Product2

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map ( payload01 , indexOfPayload01 ) -> {
Name: payload01.Name, Id: payload01.Id, ExternalId: payload01.ExternalId, ProductCode: payload01.ProductCode, CurrencyCode__c: payload01.CurrencyCode__c, ProductPrice__c: ((payload01.ProductPrice__c default "0.00") as Number) as String {format: "0.00"}, Description: payload01.Description, IsActive: payload01.IsActive, IsDeleted: payload01.IsDeleted, }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload filter ((item, index) -> item.IsDeleted == "false")
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload filter ((item, index) -> item.IsDeleted == "true")

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { totalProducts: sizeOf(vars.nonDeletedProducts), products: vars.nonDeletedProducts }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import * from dw::core::Strings --- payload map (item, index) -> { Name: item.name, ProductCode: item.productCode, ExternalId: "P" ++ ((uuid() replace "-" with "")[0 to 10]), IsActive: item.isActive default true, CurrencyCode__c: "USD", ProductPrice__c: item.productPrice as Number default 0.00, Description: item.description default null }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- payload map (item, index) -> { Id: item.Id, Name: item.Name, IsActive: item.IsActive, CurrencyCode__c: item.CurrencyCode, ProductPrice__c: item.ProductPrice, Description: item.Description }
